remarks:
All the charm of yesteryear with the added benefit of income potential in an unbeatable location! This spacious circa-1860 Victorian duplex sits on over one acre in the heart of the Village of Youngstown, offering water views & a rare lot extending from Main Street through to Second Street. The expansive property provides exceptional flexibility & is ideal for additional outbuildings, creating a one-of-a-kind outdoor living & entertaining space, or potentially subdividing for additional investment opportunities. The stately main residence features 5 bedrooms & 2.5 baths, blending historic character with thoughtful modern updates. Inside, you'll find stunning inlaid hardwood floors, soaring ceilings, generous living spaces & timeless architectural details throughout. The main residence features a spacious living rm, formal dining rm, family rm, den, bonus rm, eat-in kitchen, first-floor laundry & 2 staircases. Recent improvements include an updated kitchen & baths, custom replacement windows, new mechanical systems, roofs on both the home & barn, split A/C unit & newer carpeting. Charming fireplaces, French doors, a bay window, multiple porches, a large enclosed patio & an expansive rear patio provide inviting spaces to relax, entertain, and enjoy breathtaking sunsets. The third-floor offers a peaceful escape with beautiful views of the Niagara River, while the full basement houses updated mechanicals & provides additional storage. Complementing the main home is a fully updated one-bedroom, one-bath apartment located at the rear of the property, complete with a private entrance & separate utilities. Currently occupied by a long-term tenant, this unit offers immediate rental income & excellent investment appeal, while also providing flexibility for future use as guest quarters, in-law accommodations, or a private studio.
A substantial barn offers storage & workspace, accommodating vehicles, RVs, boats, equipment, workshops, hobbies & more. This property is located steps from restaurants, the waterfront & public boat docks. This one-of-a-kind estate delivers an exceptional lifestyle in one of WNY's most desirable waterfront communities.
